where: Section 1 formula and Worked example 1, step 3
problem: The example says the TRU is 'fed from a 115 V three-phase AC bus' and then puts 115 V into the formula as V_LL. On aircraft, a 115 V three-phase system means 115 V line-to-neutral; the line-to-line voltage is about 200 V (115 × √3 = 199.2 V). Using 115 V as V_LL gives a line current of 30.6 A, but a real TRU on that bus would draw about 6087 / (√3 × 200) = 17.6 A.
fix: State the voltage level explicitly. Either write 'fed from a 200 V line-to-line (115 V line-to-neutral) three-phase bus' and use V_LL = 200 V, giving I_line = 6086.96 / (1.732 × 200) = 17.6 A; or keep the numbers but say clearly 'for this exercise take the line-to-line voltage as 115 V'. Same clarification for the 115 V three-phase bus in Quiz Q4.
